key.name: toggle-lower-panel
key.summary: Switch the lower panel on or off
key.description: The key right of F12; asus-zenbook-duo-ux8406-keyboard-bpf delivers it as F18, which the keyboard layout names XF86Launch9.

key.name: swap-windows
key.summary: Swap the windows of the two panels
key.description: F8 in the special-key mode; asus-zenbook-duo-ux8406-keyboard-bpf delivers it as F19.
